_readme: Pinned lint/type baseline, gated by tools.health SUITE-04. It exists because OG-02's error count drifted across three different values in three documents over two phases, with nothing measuring it — and because this session's own edits silently took ruff from 22 to 26 before a manual measurement caught it. A number nobody compares is decoration.
_mypy_note: Zero since 2026-10-10 (OG-268). It had been 22 and, measured on the 1.0.14 tag with the current `uvx mypy`, was already 30: the check runs the LATEST mypy and ruff, and a newer mypy flags what an older one did not (bundled PyYAML stubs dropped, bare `dict` generics, `Returning Any` from json boundaries). Fixed in the code, not re-pinned upward: annotations, `str()` at the json boundaries, and `# type: ignore[import-untyped,unused-ignore]` / `[import-untyped,import-not-found,unused-ignore]` on the two optional or stub-less imports (PyYAML, weasyprint) so the result does not depend on which stubs happen to be installed. The ceiling may only go DOWN.
_ruff_note: Zero is the pin, not a baseline to live with. Reached 2026-08-20 by fixing two real bugs (an undefined `RoutedEdge` annotation, two ambiguous implicit string concatenations inside list literals) plus safe autofixes.
